# add at alias

Add a shell command `at <offset>` that prints the date `git at` would use, so the offset arithmetic can be checked before committing:

```bash
$ at -3d
2021-01-03 ...
```

and extend the parser to combined offsets:

```bash
$ at -3d2h1m
2021-01-02 ...
```
